messages:
rachel (sec): Quick heads-up - overnight KMS rotate completed and a small set of base-image pushes failed verification in prod. Not a pager but needs coordination before any re-signs.

marc (infra): saw the alert. ERROR from builder: `cosign: verification failed: signature not found` and one runner hit `403 registry upload`. Looks like a mismatch between cosign plugin versions on builder vs verifier. Filed INC-4801.

jin (runtime): are builders using the new kms-plugin v1.3 while verifier still expects v2 plugin protocol? That can cause different signature envelope formats.

marc (infra): correct — our fleet patched builders to `cosign-plugin-kms v1.3` but verifier pods still on cosign v2.0.2 libs. We should avoid re-signing until libs align.

rachel (sec): plan: (1) snapshot affected image manifests + existing signatures to s3://redwood-image-backups/kms-rotate-1765/ (immutable), (2) create ephemeral SA `image-rekey-sa` with minimal `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign` and a tightly-scoped `storage.objectViewer` for the backup bucket, (3) upgrade verifier libs to cosign v2.0.3 in canary, (4) run re-sign job pinned to cosign v2.0.3. Audit: export signing events to auditpipe -> bigquery and copy immutable objects to s3.

ava (oncall): adding quick rollback snippets: 
```
# revert verifier to previous image
kubectl set image deployment/verifier verifier=image.registry/redwood/verifier:stable -n security
kubectl rollout status deployment/verifier -n security
# revoke ephemeral SA
gcloud iam service-accounts remove-iam-policy-binding image-rekey-sa@redwood --role=roles/cloudkms.signerLimited
```

marc (infra): infra will stage the `image-rekey-sa` with limited bindings and deploy a k8s Job `rekey-job` pinned to nodes with builder taint. Will include preflight: `cosign version && cosign verify sample` and fail early if mismatched.

rachel (sec): audit requirements: every re-sign operation must emit a signed audit event with fields: image, old_signature_id, new_signature_id, signer_key_version, operator. Those events must land in auditpipe -> BigQuery dataset `security_image_audits` and be immutable-exported to s3. Retention 2y.

jin (runtime): verifier change: add feature flag `verifier.accept_legacy_kms=false` default false. During handoff we'll enable it in 5% canary, emit telemetry `kms_handoff=1765555555` and escalate if error rate >0.5%.

audit-bot: created ticket INC-4801 and PR link github.com/redwood-infra/image-signer/pull/78. Backup bucket path: s3://redwood-image-backups/kms-rotate-1765/.

rachel (sec): schedule maintenance window: 2026-04-12T22:00:00Z for 45m. Run on canary repos then prod if clean. Run trivy quick-scan and SBOM diff after re-sign; abort on any digest drift. Tag me and ava on failures. :lock:
